jobPostingInfo.title: Staff Software Engineer - Scheduling Tools
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
The Work

A staff engineer to hold the technical line on an internal tool: what goes in, what comes out, and what stays out.

The group works two days a week in the office so that the design arguments happen in a room.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Depth: 10+ years of professional software development.

Applicants must have the right to work in Ireland for the whole of their employment. Fabrikam does not sponsor a work permit for this position.

An annual bonus is offered under the terms of the company plan. Pay for this role is set on hire and is not posted.
